title: Incorrect parameters bricks certain functions
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In solidity, if a function parameter list has an array of defined length, it forces the user to pass an array of that length. The call reverts if the passed array is of an unexpected length.
